candidate.rationale: The ToRef trait (shared spec) already requires res.deep_view() == self.deep_view(), so adding the same postcondition on this impl would be redundant (checker flagged 'already_specified_via_trait'). The verifier errors in the harness are import/module issues, not a gap in the spec. No stronger, non-vacuous guarantee (e.g., pointer-identity/aliasing) can be soundly expressed with the available vstd spec vocabulary.
risks: Cannot express a stronger alias/pointer-identity guarantee with current public vstd specs; users wanting that will not get it.
If harness/import errors are fixed later, adding an identical impl-level ensures would be provable but unnecessary maintenance noise.
